verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's core value proposition is directly delivering clean, LLM-ready markdown (result.markdown) instead of raw HTML, with dedicated features like Fit Markdown (noise-filtering heuristics), BM25-based content filtering, and citation/reference extraction specifically for AI-friendly processing. It also handles the rendering/blocking pain points itself (JS execution, stealth/undetected browser modes, proxy rotation, retries) so the user never has to deal with them, and community feedback corroborates it 'solves many LLM-scraping headaches.' Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of markdown quality vs. raw HTML extraction, and some production concerns (rate limiting, bot mitigation robustness) are noted as caveats by users.
